title: Cumberland Cove
description:
Relax with a full house to yourself with the whole family at this peaceful place to stay. Fabulous view on the Cumberland River and the Nashville Skyline. Guests enjoy the spacious backyard feeling away from the hustle and bustle but only 5 minutes away from the action of Downtown. Due to the fact this is my primary residence  I sometimes stay on edge of premises in completely separate unit on very edge of property.I strive to give guests as much privacy as possible and have a separate entrance.

The space
Lovely  brick house on the river. It has a wonderful view of downtown skyline. Three bedrooms 2 full baths. Carport social area..And wonderful flower gardens in the spring and summer. Only 5 minutes from downtown but far enough away to not have city sounds etc.

Guest access
front door, or main gate..very little steps to entrance easily accessible.

Other things to note
If there are and emergencies concerning the house /guest call owner immediately. Read rules  respect them..And feel free to ask any questions and I will try to help or accommodate you in any way i can.  Guest will receive 1 key and a personal quick walk through and summary of property.
